cohort: The study included 160 preterm neonates from Tehran, comprising 80 neonates with NEC (cases) and 80 randomly selected neonates who survived NEC (controls).
finding: Absolute monocyte count (AMC) and absolute white blood cell (WBC) count were significantly different between preterm neonates with and without NEC, with AMC being lower and WBC higher in the NEC group.
cross-section timing: Data from medical records and laboratory findings were reviewed in 2017.
birth_weight: Mean birth weights were 1500 ± 488 g in the NEC group and 1562 ± 360 g in the control group.
gest_age: Mean gestational ages were 30.78 ± 2.33 weeks in the NEC group and 31.41 ± 2.16 weeks in the control group.
